searchText: late to the party but Nethermind disconnects based on FCU and finalized block hash, if the peer doesn't have finalized block we disconnect it. but that's not ok if the peer is syncing, it will not have the finalized block so your rule would effectively disconnect all syncing peers do we have a new deadline for trying to drop history on sepolia? ^ or what is the plan? We're happy to include history expiry as a topic on ACDT and push for it over the next weeks to get it on mainnet. June 1 deadline? bump on this Also would like to begin testing dropping history at arbitrary heights, not just pre merge. It would be very good to have a flag to do that (even if its a dev flag/hidden flag). I'm guessing to ensure that new peers can still sync, we would need to have the portal stack ran in kurtosis too for this? <@240180844130598912> how complex is the portal stack right now? could I run a single docker container and be up and running? <@412614104222531604> I think we'd need to do some experiments to make this work but I think it's doable. Few things come to mind: - Likely some modifications we'd need to do on our end because much of what is in the clients is mainnet centric and my guess is that there'd be a few things that would need to be adjusted to make the clients network agnostic. - Tiny networks of only a small number of nodes may behave weird. Again, likely small client modifications necessary to make this work. - Initializing data into those nodes would also probably need a little work. We have our weekly implementers call happening in 20 minutes. Link will be announced in <#1331655016993394770> . I'll add this as an agenda item for us to discuss.

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content:
<@412614104222531604> I think we'd need to do some experiments to make this work but I think it's doable.  Few things come to mind:

- Likely some modifications we'd need to do on our end because much of what is in the clients is mainnet centric and my guess is that there'd be a few things that would need to be adjusted to make the clients network agnostic.
- Tiny networks of only a small number of nodes may behave weird.  Again, likely small client modifications necessary to make this work.
- Initializing data into those nodes would also probably need a little work.  

We have our weekly implementers call happening in 20 minutes.  Link will be announced in <#1331655016993394770> .  I'll add this as an agenda item for us to discuss.
